items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: However, we did the "Varsity Show" and finished.

ctx.x: Oh, long before that in the theaters in New York, I was doing

sand. I messed with sand for quite a while. When I was doing it for Dick Powell there in that picture, I had it pretty much under control, 'cause I knew what I was doing. You can see, look at me -- see -- I was doing what I was doing. It wasn't like me trying to find something. I shuffled and everything from that picture, you can look at it and tell,'cause I did the sand there -- Sandman tried to do a step that he didn't complete so much as I completed mine. I did a step -- zee-zap-zee with one foot, then I'd…
However, we did the "Varsity Show" and finished.
